title: Deeper at constant width: 8 -> 10 layers, dim stays 512
description: DEPTH 8 -> 10 and ASPECT_RATIO 64 -> 48 so model_dim stays 512 with 4 heads of 128; pure depth change, nothing else touched.
reflection: Capacity is the binding constraint, not optimization. val_bpb 0.989341 vs baseline 0.997358 (-0.0080, ~9x the round-0 noise floor of ~0.0009). Params 50.3M -> 60.8M, FLOPs/token 2.39e8 -> 2.96e8 (+24%), so tokens fell 412M -> 376.8M (2875 steps) -- and it still won by a wide margin, so trading ~9% of the token budget for 25% more depth is clearly profitable. Bonus: steady-state MFU ROSE 33.1% -> 37.4% (deeper blocks amortize the per-step optimizer/Python overhead over more compute), so part of the extra depth was free. Peak VRAM 22.2 -> 27.2 GB, still fine. Still epoch 1, i.e. no data reuse, so this is not a memorization artifact. Next: push further along the same axis (DEPTH 12 with ASPECT_RATIO 40 keeps dim 512) until the token loss stops paying for itself.
